caption: The drawing features two main objects. At the top, there is a circular compass rose with a beige background, divided into thirty-two segments, each marked with tick lines and directional notations around the edge. The segments are decorated with alternating colorful motifs in blue, yellow, red, and orange, arranged symmetrically, with a central rosette in green, brown, and yellow. Below this, there is a three-dimensional depiction of a dark brown, rectangular wooden box with metal handles on its sides. The open box reveals the same compass rose design seen in the top object, set into the interior lid. A small square lid, featuring an inlaid geometric design, is shown leaning against the front of the box, partially removed to display the inside. The composition is set against a plain, light beige background.
title: Floating Compass
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
